rules.text: Muatan Lokal covers local potential (seni budaya, prakarya, PJOK, bahasa, teknologi) and may be integrated into other subjects, into kokurikuler, or taught as a separate subject.
rules.ref: Permendikdasmen 13/2025, Lampiran II B–E explanations (PDF p. 21, 25, 33, 40)

rules.text: Inclusive schools add the subject Program Kebutuhan Khusus according to the students' needs.
Koding dan Kecerdasan Artifisial is an elective the school may offer according to its resources; schools start offering it gradually from 2025/2026 (Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Pasal 32A).
rules.ref: Permendikdasmen 13/2025, Lampiran II explanations; Permendikdasmen 13/2025 Pasal 32A (PDF p. 5)

rules.text: Until 2026/2027 an elective that schools offer when ready; compulsory from 2027/2028 (Permendikbudristek 12/2024 Pasal 33 huruf a, not amended by Permendikdasmen 13/2025).
Special sport or arts classes or schools may use the kokurikuler time to strengthen sport or arts.
rules.ref: Permendikdasmen 13/2025, Lampiran II C–D explanations (PDF p. 25, 33)

rules.text: PKL is taught in blocks of 46 JP per week; Matematika, Bahasa Inggris, Informatika and Koding dan Kecerdasan Artifisial follow the context of the programme.
rules.ref: Permendikdasmen 13/2025, Lampiran II E explanations (PDF p. 39)

rules.text: Bahasa Inggris in SMPLB and SMALB is compulsory for students without intellectual disability and optional for students with intellectual disability; time allocation is flexible; the phase follows a diagnostic assessment; SMALB grade XI does PKL for the skill subject for at least one month.
rules.ref: Permendikdasmen 13/2025, Lampiran II H explanations (PDF p. 64–65)

rules.text: The structure is set by the head of the madrasah with at least these allocations; the madrasah may add at most 6 JP per week based on its analysis of learning outcomes and available time.
Muatan lokal follows the madrasah's character and local potential: keagamaan, seni budaya, prakarya, PJOK, bahasa, teknologi and/or riset (LB: without keagamaan and riset).
A madrasah with a special programme may use the muatan lokal (MTs) or penguatan program (MA) time for religious, sport or arts strengthening; MA: grades X–XI 72–216 JP, grade XII 64–192 JP.
Kokurikuler team: subject teachers whose kokurikuler time is moved may be facilitators (1 JP per class); the coordinator's load equals 2 teaching hours per class per year, at most 3 classes.
Until 2026/2027 an elective that schools offer when ready; compulsory from 2027/2028 (Permendikbudristek 12/2024 Pasal 33 huruf a, not amended by Permendikdasmen 13/2025).

notes: Pick the table by `levels` (SD, MI, SMP, MTs, SMA, MA, SMK, MAK, SDLB, MILB, SMPLB, MTsLB, SMALB, MALB) and grade. Madrasah use the KMA tables (source KMA); MI/MTs/MA/MAK also appear in the Permendikdasmen tables, which the KMA adapts for madrasah.

A row's `group`: wajib, pilihan, muatan_lokal; SMK/MAK: umum, kejuruan, pilihan, muatan_lokal. Printed '-' is 0; ranges are [min, max]. Elective blocks (pilihan_sma, pilihan_ma) list `options`, `choose` and the JP per elective.
Weekly JP = JP per tahun / weeks_per_year; the decrees print yearly figures only. Kokurikuler is an annual allocation, so a weekly kokurikuler figure is only an equivalent.
`errata` lists printed cells that contradict the table's own totals; rows keep the printed value in `printed_*` and totals in `printed_jp`.
